observations.finding: Robot reports game state, offers grid-target advice and requests accept/reject decisions; status updates and response options appear in the actual interaction, not merely in voice samples.
observations.limit: E2/G01 adjudication belongs to R006; voice sound bytes not heard.

observations.finding: Online six-voice suitability/intelligibility ratings used to select two voices for the main experiment; this is not automatically an eligible operational system-message experiment.
observations.limit: R006 must separately determine whether this phase meets E2.

observations.finding: Two between-subject voice conditions; robot speech includes task status and action-oriented advice. Participants randomly assigned; each participant receives nine advice opportunities; actions and response times measured.
observations.limit: Nine advice opportunities are repeated observations, not separate participants or samples.

observations.finding: Author reports 62 completing the voice-selection pre-study, with two failing a control question, giving 60 analysed.
observations.limit: Counts are author-reported, not new R006 study/sample admission.

observations.finding: Author reports 73 completing main experiment and five excluded due to technical issues, leaving 68 analysed, evenly allocated between two experimental conditions.
observations.limit: Counts are author-reported; no raw data or participant identifiers inspected.

observations.finding: Article explicitly states online pre-study participants were excluded from participating in the main study. Within this publication, authors therefore attest distinct recruitment pools for these two phases.
observations.limit: This statement does not verify individual identities, resolve the separately described pilot group, or establish independence from other publications.

observations.finding: Separate campus pilot with eight participants is described before the main experiment; exact overlap with analysed main study and pre-study groups is not established here.
observations.limit: Do not add eight as independent admitted participants; pilot function and design eligibility require R006 assessment.

observations.finding: Robot has 76 utterance variants and expressive gestures/faces; recorded examples include apologetic, hopeful, angry, sad and supportive speech. This is not a clean comparison of affectless versus affective machine voices.
observations.limit: No audio waveforms listened to and no acoustical equivalence established; only documented utterance and procedure descriptions.
